description: Change the target URL (or title, or pause/activate) of an existing code. Printed copies keep working and now lead to the new target. Needs the API key of the owner or the edit_url of an anonymous code.

active.description: false pauses the code (scanners see a friendly note)

code.description: The short code, e.g. "k7Fq2" (the part after ?c= in the short URL)

edit_key.description: For codes created without an API key: the edit_url (or its key) returned at creation

name: update_qr_code
title: Change where a QR code leads
